item.title: [Recap] Victor Wembanyama (SAS): Victor Wembanyama had himself a night with 30 points (10-of-18 FGs, 6-of-9 FTs), 14 rebounds, two assists, two blocks and four three-pointers in Friday’s 124-109 win over the Kings.
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama had himself a night with 30 points (10-of-18 FGs, 6-of-9 FTs), 14 rebounds, two assists, two blocks and four three-pointers in Friday’s 124-109 win over the Kings.

Wembanyama just took advantage of the Kings defense and got whatever he wanted. What is notable is that he did role his ankle near the end of the first half due to a Sabonis closeout, so it’s possible he shows up on the injury report, but he did finish the game which is good to see. Compared to his stat line last game, this performance seems like a letdown which goes to show how good Wembanyama is.

Brian Taylor
